subject: Demo for Stratus Health — VP wants to join, need to move time
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rory Blake <rory@stratushealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood demo — March 4, 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET

Hi Rory,

Thanks again for the time today — excited to walk the Stratus Health team through the Redwood inference workflow. Per our note, we've penciled the technical demo for:

  • Thursday, March 4 — 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET

Agenda attached (agenda_v1.pdf). Intended attendees: Samir (CTO), you, product, and a couple of engineers from your side. Evelyn from my team will lead the run-through and Markus will cover deployment/ops.

If anything changes on your side, let me know and we can adjust. I'll send an updated calendar invite and Teams link later today.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachments: agenda_v1.pdf, redwood-demo.ics

From: Rory Blake <rory@stratushealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — March 4, 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET

Thanks Ben — appreciate the agenda. Quick update: Samir (our CTO) wants to be on the call but he just got put on travel for March 4 — he can make March 5 at 2:00 PM ET or March 8 between 11:00 AM–2:00 PM ET.

Is it possible to move to March 5 at 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET so Samir can join? That would be ideal from our side.

Also can you add a one-slide summary for security/hosting (SOC2, VPC options) so we can share with Samir ahead of time?

Thanks — Rory
Rory Blake
Head of Product Ops, Stratus Health
rory@stratushealth.com | +1 617-555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 13:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Redwood demo — need to shift for VP/CTO

Evelyn / Markus — Rory just flagged that their CTO (Samir) will only be available March 5 at 2:00 PM ET. Can we move our demo from Mar 4 11:00 PT to Mar 5 11:00 PT?

Questions:
  1) Evelyn — can you lead March 5 at that time?
  2) Markus — can you cover the deployment/ops section and prepare a one-slide SOC2/VPC hosting summary (2–3 bullets + link to SOC2 report)?
  3) Will this conflict with any other prioritized customer sessions next week?

If we need to keep Mar 4, we can also offer a short prep call for Samir, but I'd prefer to have him in the live session.

Thanks — Ben

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood demo — need to shift for VP/CTO

Ben — I can absolutely lead on March 5 at 11:00 AM PT. I've got the deep-dive flow and can tighten the security slide into the front 5 minutes for Samir's context.

Markus — can you drop the SOC2/VPC bullet points into the shared Drive folder (link below) by EOD today? I'll weave them into the deck and send an updated PDF.

Per the calendar, shifting from Mar 4 to Mar 5 doesn't conflict with any other pre-scheduled executive sessions on our side.

-Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com

  • Thursday, March 5 — 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET (Evelyn will run; Markus will cover SOC2/VPC summary)

I've attached an updated agenda (updated_agenda_v2.pdf) and re-sent the calendar invite (redwood-demo.ics). Samir I've CC'd you here — please let us know if you'd like any other pre-read before the call.
